findings.label: issue
findings.subject: Session cookie with the JWT is no longer HttpOnly, exposing it to JavaScript (XSS token theft)
findings.discussion: The auth cookie carries the session JWT. Setting httponly=False lets any injected script read document.cookie and exfiltrate the token, turning any XSS into full account takeover. The PR title 'Update auth' does not disclose this security weakening. There is no apparent need for the frontend to read this cookie, since the token is also returned in the response body.

judge.rationale: The comment says the session cookie is no longer HttpOnly and is therefore readable from JavaScript, enabling XSS token theft, which is exactly the seeded defect.
